confidence_notes: Food anchors use aggregated Nairobi prices updated in October 2026. Cocktail is estimated at about 2.8 times local beer and wine at about 1.5 times; accommodation anchors are holistic estimates without live listing checks.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single city substitute used. The regional basis is Nairobi as a major East African capital; food and drink anchors use Nairobi-specific aggregated prices.
